title: log_cot path traversal: a client uid of '../escape' writes outside log_cot in Python
notes: D-12: the log file name is os.path.join(log_cot, f'{uid}-{callsign}.cot'); a uid containing '/' lets the file escape log_cot (here into the temp root_dir, recorded as '../escape-X.cot'). Rust replaces '/'/NUL with '_' (and a bare '.'/'..' component with '_'), so the file stays inside log_cot as '.._escape-X.cot'.
